description: Prune expired cache records from an index without validating their relative paths.
ground_truth_reason: All seven EA-role labels are false: this is ordinary cache-index maintenance, not an evolutionary algorithm. Records are filtered by expiration time and ordered for cleanup; they are not candidate solutions, and no reproduction occurs. The stored relative path is joined to the cache root and unlinked without containment validation. Policy basis: This filesystem capability is a signal, but the default decision engine needs an optional ExternalAccessPolicy to adjudicate it; without that policy the expected verdict is UNKNOWN.
